title: Permutations
contract: Return all permutations of distinct integers as sorted textual arrays. Input length ≤ 8 for examples.
reasoning: Generate length-n choices from all n indices, then reject candidates that repeat an index.
Track used indices while building the path so invalid prefixes are never expanded.
There are n! valid outputs, so pruning cannot eliminate factorial output cost. Undo both path addition and the used flag. Duplicate input values require an additional same-depth duplicate rule.
complexity: O(n·nⁿ + output sorting), O(n) recursion excluding output
O(n·n! + output sorting), O(n) recursion excluding output
